answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using zero-knowledge passport nullifiers. Operators submit a ZK-SNARK verifying a state-signed NFC passport to derive a scoped nullifier, blocking duplicate keys while keeping user data private. Anchored like seasoned timber, this ferrous check forces attackers to acquire a scarce physical passport per identity, making valid slots rare as saffron. However, brokers can rent human documents, and people without NFC passports are excluded.
